patthana23.29:1.1: na sekkhaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sekkho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana23.29:2.1: na sekkhaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nevasekkhānāsekkho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.29:3.1: na sekkhaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nevasekkhānāsekkho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca. naparittattika nakusalattike parittattika kusalattikaṃ
